source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Using the chosen layout, players agree which edges of their battlefield match the Attacker's and Defender's edges marked on the card. Then roll off; the winner chooses which team is Attacker and which Defender.
